_comment: Approximate, rounded literature values for educational use only. Concentrations are plasma concentrations; mg/L equals ug/mL. dose_conversion converts mg of the administered dose to the amount unit of the concentration (1.0 for mg->mg; lithium carbonate -> mmol Li+). t_half_range_h is an illustrative inter-patient variability band.

drugs.name: Paracetamol (acetaminophen)
drugs.notes: MTC is a conservative modelling threshold; hepatotoxicity risk is dose- and time-dependent (acute overdose is assessed with the Rumack-Matthew nomogram).

drugs.name: Amoxicillin
drugs.notes: Time-dependent killing: efficacy tracks time above the pathogen MIC. MEC here is an illustrative MIC for susceptible organisms; the upper limit is an arbitrary educational reference (wide therapeutic index).

drugs.name: Lithium (carbonate)
drugs.dose_basis: mg lithium carbonate (1 mg = 0.02707 mmol Li+)
drugs.notes: Maintenance window 0.6-1.2 mmol/L (trough, 12 h post-dose); toxicity above 1.5 mmol/L. The MTC used for the red zone is 1.5; levels of 1.2-1.5 are flagged as the upper edge of the window.

drugs.name: Diazepam
drugs.notes: Parent compound only; the active metabolite desmethyldiazepam (t1/2 up to about 100 h) is not modelled.
